prompt_output_contract.bounded_output_rule: Analyze every input unit and its material obligations and exceptions. Aim for no more than 40 claims per call; never silently omit scope to satisfy an output target. If evidence is insufficient, create explicit unknowns. No eight-item summary cap.
prompt_output_contract.claim_rule: Every claim has report_section, narrative_role, topic_key, source_unit_ids, requirement_ids, related_claim_ids and is_key_point. Use the same topic_key for a condition, its impact, action and decision condition. Connect claims with related_claim_ids; inferences also require premise_claim_ids and reason. Distinguish fact, inference, opinion and unknown. Keep exceptions, scope and assumptions in body. Do not reduce the body to labels. related_claim_ids must contain only claim_id values declared in this response or supplied verified_claims. Never use evidence_id, profile_evidence_id or source unit IDs there. If an optional connection is uncertain, use an empty related_claim_ids array. premise_claim_ids remain mandatory for inferences and calculations; never omit required premises. Synthesis must still connect every supplied claim.
prompt_output_contract.coverage_rule: For requirements_and_evaluation and delivery_risk_economics return coverage for every supplied source unit (its requirement_id is the unit ID, not a real document requirement ID). Link each row to substantive local claims which explain the content, or mark needs_review with a reason. Copy only supplied document requirement_ids into claims and account for every supplied requirement ID; mentioning IDs alone is not analysis. In synthesis coverage is empty; considered_claim_ids must include every supplied verified_claims ID and each must be related to a new synthesis claim. considered_claim_ids refers only to claim_id values in supplied input_slice.verified_claims, never local claim_id values created in this response. Return [] when no verified_claims are supplied.
prompt_output_contract.evidence_rule: Every fact, calculation and inference must carry exact source evidence. New evidence quotes must be exact substrings of a single supplied block. Copy locator, version and sha256 from the source. Reuse earlier evidence by ID only when supplied in this call. No invented company capabilities or numbers.
prompt_output_contract.identity_rule: Copy deep_review_id, attempt_id and stage exactly. Create new lowercase UUIDs; never redefine earlier claims or evidence.
prompt_output_contract.profile_rule: Company facts are a selected subset with selection limits. Not selected or missing is not proof of absence or noncompliance. Use only supplied evidence for company claims. Include positive evidence and the limits of transfer to this project.
prompt_output_contract.recommendation_rule: Only input_slice.synthesis_phase=global may emit exactly one category=system_recommendation claim with narrative_role=recommendation, report_section=assessment and body exactly one of 추진 검토, 조건부 추진 검토, 보류, 검토 종료. Other phases must not emit a recommendation. Global must reconcile all supplied synthesis conclusions and retain conflicting conditions as unknowns; no final bid decision.
prompt_output_contract.validation_repair_rule: When input_slice.validation_repair is present, return one complete replacement response for the same frozen slice. Correct every listed code at its field path without inventing or dropping source content, changing supplied identifiers, or weakening evidence, premise, coverage, quotation, numeric, or required-field rules.

stages.instruction: 원문 각 조각의 목적·과업·산출물·자격·평가·검수·계약·비용 조건과 예외를 충분한 문장으로 추출한다. source 역할의 사실을 각 보고서 절에 배치하고 실제 요구사항 ID와 근거를 연결한다. 읽지 못한 내용은 needs_review로 남긴다.

원문 조건과 제공된 회사 근거를 대조한다. 조건이 인력·일정·기술·검수·계약·비용에 미치는 영향과 이유·가정을 설명하고 확인할 일과 확인 결과에 따른 판단 조건까지 연결한다. company_basis, impact, action, decision_condition을 같은 topic_key와 related_claim_ids로 묶는다. 사실·해석·미확인을 구분하며 비용 자료가 없으면 계산하지 않는다.
앞 단계 검증 결과의 쟁점과 조건 간 관계를 충분한 문장으로 종합한다. 모든 입력 주장을 검토하고 핵심 판단 조건·긍정 근거·해결되지 않은 한계를 유지한다. partial에서는 종합 문장과 판단 갱신 조건을 만들고 global에서만 전체 종합 권고를 만든다. 상세 설명은 이미 보고서에 보존되므로 권고를 내기 위해 없는 사실을 추가하지 않는다.
